remarks: If you're searching for a very nice apartment, look no further! This first floor apartment with no steps offers spacious rooms & lots of natural light. Located in a small complex and convenient to everything. Enter into a foyer w/Double closets& utility closet, dining area with plenty of room for a table & chairs, a galley kitchen w/huge pantry and plenty of cabinets, stove, dishwasher & fridge. Large Living Room and Bedroom which can accommodate a king-size bed - double closets.  Laundry area with full-size washer & dryer. Full bath w/tub & shower & linen closet. Central Air and off-street parking. Recently painted and carpets professionally cleaned.  Must have excellent credit, good references. No pets.
